mainTopic: Squeezing out a bird חטאת's blood, the stages of מעילה for each קרבן, and מעילה in the ash on the מזבח
overview: The amud opens by finishing a discussion about the leftover blood of a bird חטאת. A ברייתא about the מנחה seems to show that 'leftover' means something must remain. The גמרא answers that the מנחה is different because of an extra word in the פסוק. אבוה דשמואל then challenges רב הונא from a משנה about squeezing out the blood, and he answers it himself: the משנה speaks about each bird separately (לצדדין). Two teachings of the school of רבי ישמעאל seem to clash, and the גמרא explains that two תנאים reported רבי ישמעאל's view differently. A new משנה then traces the stages of many קרבנות: when מעילה starts, when the item can become פסול, when פיגול, נותר and טמא apply, and when מעילה ends. The גמרא brings a dispute between רב and רבי יוחנן about benefiting from the ash heap on the מזבח after תרומת הדשן. רב says there is no מעילה because the מצוה is done, and רבי יוחנן says there is, because carrying out the ashes still needs בגדי כהונה. Finally, רב answers a challenge from the משנה by reading it as 'until it is fit to go out' to בית הדשן.

steps.title: A ברייתא about the מנחה: something must be left over
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the previous reading of 'leftover' from a ברייתא. The ברייתא says a מנחה is excluded if its flour, oil or frankincense is missing.
steps.simpleTranslation: But a ברייתא teaches: 'of its fine flour and of its oil, together with all its frankincense.' This excludes a case where its flour, its oil or its frankincense was missing.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to challenge the idea that 'leftover' only describes whatever happens to remain. The ברייתא shows that for a מנחה, something must actually be left.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The previous discussion read 'what remains' as a description, not a requirement. This ברייתא seems to show the opposite: the פסוק requires that some flour, oil and frankincense remain. If that is true for a מנחה, maybe the 'leftover' blood of a bird חטאת is also a requirement.

keyTerms.meaning: A teaching of the תנאים that is not in the משנה
Excludes; leaves out a certain case
Fine flour, the main part of a מנחה
Frankincense placed on the מנחה
It was missing; it was lacking

phrases.english: But isn't it taught: 'Of its fine flour and of its oil,
phrases.notes: ויקרא 2:2. This is about the כהן taking the handful from a מנחה.

phrases.english: together with all its frankincense' –
this excludes a case where its flour was missing,
or its oil was missing, or its frankincense was missing!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues a challenge from the earlier discussion about whether 'leftover' is a requirement.
steps.kashyaTarget: The reading that 'leftover' only describes whatever happens to remain
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A ברייתא shows that with a מנחה, the פסוק requires that something remain, so 'leftover' should be a requirement.

steps.title: The מנחה is different because of an extra word
steps.stepSummary: The answer: by a מנחה the פסוק says 'that which is left' an extra time, and that extra word teaches the requirement.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said: There it is written 'and that which is left'; an extra verse is written.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the מנחה is a special case. The requirement there comes from an extra word in the פסוק, not from the normal meaning of 'leftover'.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Normally, 'leftover' just describes what happens to remain. With a מנחה, the phrase 'והנותרת' appears twice, so the extra one teaches that something must remain. That extra word is not found by the bird חטאת, so the ברייתא proves nothing about it.

keyTerms.meaning: There; in that other case
And that which is left (of the מנחה)
An extra פסוק, used to teach something new

phrases.english: They said: There it is written: 'And that which is left',
an extra verse is written.
phrases.notes: The same phrase appears again in ויקרא 2:10, so one of them is extra and teaches this law.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge from the ברייתא about the מנחה.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Distinguishing the case through an extra word in the פסוק
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The requirement by the מנחה shows that 'leftover' always means something must remain.
steps.terutzMaskana: Only by the מנחה, because of the extra 'והנותרת', must something remain; elsewhere 'leftover' just describes what happens to be left.
steps.whatToRemember: The מנחה rule comes from an extra word (קרא יתירא), so it cannot be applied to the bird חטאת.

steps.title: אבוה דשמואל challenges רב הונא from a משנה
steps.stepSummary: A משנה says that both a bird חטאת and a bird עולה become invalid through a wrong intention while squeezing out the blood. This suggests squeezing out the blood matters for the bird חטאת too.
steps.simpleTranslation: אבוה דשמואל objected to רב הונא: Both a bird חטאת and a bird עולה, where the כהן did מליקה or squeezed out their blood with intent to eat or burn them outside their place: it is invalid, but there is no כרת. With intent outside their time: it is פיגול, and one is liable to כרת for it. In any case, the משנה teaches 'squeezed out their blood'!
steps.whatsHappening: אבוה דשמואל challenges רב הונא's view about the blood of a bird חטאת using a משנה. The משנה lists squeezing out the blood as a moment when a wrong intention ruins the offering.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If a wrong thought during squeezing can make the offering invalid or פיגול, then squeezing must be an important part of the service. The משנה mentions this for both birds, so it seems that squeezing is essential for the bird חטאת too. That goes against רב הונא, who treated squeezing as not essential for it.

keyTerms.meaning: A bird sin offering
A bird burnt offering
Killing a bird offering by pinching the back of its neck with the כהן's fingernail
Squeezing out the blood of the bird
An offering ruined by an intention to eat or burn it after its proper time
A heavenly punishment of being cut off

steps.confusionAlert: Wrong place (חוץ למקומו) makes the offering invalid but carries no כרת. Wrong time (חוץ לזמנו) makes it פיגול, and eating it carries כרת. Don't mix up the two.

phrases.english: Shmuel's father raised an objection to Rav Huna:

phrases.aramaic: אֶחָד חַטַּאת הָעוֹף וְאֶחָד עוֹלַת הָעוֹף
phrases.english: Both a bird sin offering and a bird burnt offering
where he pinched their necks or squeezed out their blood outside their place –
phrases.notes: He means: with a plan to eat or burn them outside the place where they belong.

phrases.english: it is invalid, and there is no כרת for it.
Outside their time – it is פיגול,
and one is liable to כרת for it.
In any case, it teaches 'squeezed out their blood'!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new challenge, this time directly against רב הונא, from a משנה in זבחים.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב הונא's view that squeezing out the blood of a bird חטאת is not essential
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה makes squeezing a moment when wrong intention disqualifies both birds, so squeezing must be essential even for the bird חטאת.
steps.whyThisMatters: Intention only ruins an offering during an essential part of the service, so this משנה is a strong test of what counts as essential.

steps.title: The משנה speaks about each bird separately
steps.stepSummary: אבוה דשמואל answers his own question: the משנה is split. Squeezing out the blood refers only to the bird עולה.
steps.simpleTranslation: He raised the objection and he answered it: it teaches each case on its own side.
steps.whatsHappening: The same person who asked the question now answers it. He explains that the משנה is not saying both actions apply to both birds.
steps.deeperAnalysis: 'לצדדין' means the משנה lists cases that belong to different birds. מליקה applies to both birds, but squeezing out the blood is the key act only for the bird עולה. So the משנה does not prove that squeezing is essential for the bird חטאת, and רב הונא stands.

keyTerms.meaning: Raises an objection
Resolves; answers the objection
It teaches each part about a different case

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה is read לצדדין: מליקה is for both birds, and squeezing is for the bird עולה. So רב הונא's view about the bird חטאת is not disproved.

phrases.aramaic: הוּא מוֹתֵיב לַהּ וְהוּא מְפָרֵק לַהּ:
phrases.english: He raised the objection and he resolved it:
It teaches the cases separately.
phrases.notes: Pinching the neck goes with both birds; squeezing the blood goes only with the bird עולה.

steps.triggerLanguage: הוּא מוֹתֵיב לַהּ וְהוּא מְפָרֵק לַהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge from the משנה in step 3.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rereading the משנה as split between cases (לצדדין)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה says squeezing out the blood matters for both the bird חטאת and the bird עולה.
steps.terutzMaskana: Squeezing out the blood in the משנה refers only to the bird עולה, so it is not proven essential for the bird חטאת.

steps.title: Back to the teaching of the school of רבי ישמעאל
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא returns to the ברייתא itself: squeezing out the blood is needed only if some blood happens to be left.
steps.simpleTranslation: Now to the teaching itself. The school of רבי ישמעאל taught: the blood is squeezed out only if some blood is left.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא goes back to the ברייתא it quoted earlier and looks at it on its own terms. This sets up a question in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא reads the words 'that which is left' to mean 'if any blood is left.' So squeezing out the blood is not a must. If no blood is left, or the blood was never squeezed out, the bird חטאת is still valid.

keyTerms.meaning: 'The matter itself': the גמרא returns to a source it quoted earlier to look at it directly
Is left over or remains
Squeezing out the blood of a bird offering against the wall of the מזבח

phrases.english: The matter itself:
The tanna of the school of Rabbi Yishmael taught:
That is, if any of the blood remains.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After settling the משנה as a split, the גמרא goes back to look directly at the ברייתא of the school of רבי ישמעאל.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to this ברייתא, squeezing out the blood of a bird חטאת is needed only if blood is left, so it does not hold back the offering.

steps.title: The same school seems to teach the opposite
steps.stepSummary: Another teaching of the school of רבי ישמעאל says the leftover blood is essential. רב פפא explains that this is about squeezing out a bird חטאת, so the two teachings clash.
steps.simpleTranslation: But the school of רבי ישמעאל taught elsewhere that the leftover blood holds back the offering. And רב פפא said the difference between them and רבי עקיבא is the squeezing out of a bird חטאת!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a teaching from the same school that seems to say the exact opposite of the ברייתא it just quoted.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In זבחים, the school of רבי ישמעאל says 'שיריים מעכבין', the leftover blood holds back the offering. רב פפא explains this means that failing to squeeze out a bird חטאת makes it פסול. That clashes with step 5, where squeezing out is not a must.

keyTerms.meaning: The leftover blood, after the main placing of the blood
Hold back: without it, the offering is פסול
A bird sin offering
This is the practical difference between the two opinions

phrases.aramaic: וְהָא תָּנָא דְּבֵי רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל הָתָם:
phrases.english: But the school of Rabbi Yishmael taught there:
The remainder of the blood is essential;
And Rav Pappa said:
The squeezing out of a bird sin offering
Is the difference between them!
phrases.notes: 'Them' means the school of רבי ישמעאל and רבי עקיבא, who argue there.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְהָא תָּנָא דְּבֵי רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל הָתָם
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges step 5 with a different teaching from the same school.
steps.kashyaTarget: The ברייתא in step 5, which treats squeezing out the blood as not essential.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Through רב פפא's explanation, the same school of רבי ישמעאל holds that failing to squeeze out a bird חטאת makes it פסול. One school cannot hold both views.

steps.title: Two תנאים disagree about רבי ישמעאל's view
steps.stepSummary: The two teachings come from two different תנאים, and each reports רבי ישמעאל's opinion differently.
steps.simpleTranslation: There are two תנאים, and they argue about what רבי ישמעאל held.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the clash: two different תנאים each passed down a different version of רבי ישמעאל's view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The גמרא does not try to make the two teachings agree. It accepts that they really disagree and says the disagreement is between two students reporting their teacher's view. One version says squeezing out the blood is essential; the other says it is not.

keyTerms.meaning: Two תנאים who disagree
According to, on the view of

steps.whatToRemember: The school of רבי ישמעאל was passed down in two versions. In one, squeezing out a bird חטאת is essential. In the other, it is needed only if blood is left.

phrases.english: There are two tanna'im,
And they disagree with regard to the opinion of Rabbi Yishmael.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of step 6.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Disagreement between תנאים: two reporters of the same master's view
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Both teachings come from one consistent view of the school of רבי ישמעאל, so they contradict each other.
steps.terutzMaskana: Two תנאים differ in reporting רבי ישמעאל's view, so there is no contradiction within any one view.

steps.title: The stages of a bird עולה
steps.stepSummary: The new משנה explains when מעילה starts for a bird עולה, when it can become פסול, when פיגול, נותר and טמא apply, and when מעילה ends.
steps.simpleTranslation: A bird עולה: מעילה applies from the time it is made holy. Once its neck is pinched, it can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight. Once its blood is squeezed out, one is liable for it because of פיגול, נותר and טמא. And מעילה applies until it goes out to the place of the ashes.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה starts. It walks through the life of a bird עולה step by step and says which laws kick in at each stage.
steps.deeperAnalysis: There are four stages. Being made holy brings מעילה. מליקה makes it fit, so it can now become פסול. Squeezing out the blood finishes the main service, so פיגול, נותר and טמא apply. מעילה lasts until it reaches the place of the ashes.

keyTerms.meaning: Short for מתניתין: here begins a משנה
One is liable for מעילה, misusing holy property
Its neck was pinched with the fingernail, the way a bird offering is killed
Someone who went to the מקוה today but must wait for nightfall to be fully טהור
Someone who still has to bring an atonement offering to finish becoming טהור
The place where the ashes are taken

steps.confusionAlert: 'הוכשרה ליפסל' does not mean it became ready for use. It means it is now at the stage where it can become פסול.

phrases.english: MISHNA:
A bird burnt offering: one is liable for misusing it from the moment it was consecrated.
Once its neck was pinched, it became able to be disqualified by one who immersed that day,
And by one who has not yet brought an atonement offering, and by being left overnight.
Once its blood was squeezed out,
One is liable for it due to piggul,
Notar, and ritual impurity.
And one is liable for misusing it
Until it goes out to the place of the ashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new משנה begins. It starts tracking the stages of each קרבן, beginning with a bird עולה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For a bird עולה: מעילה applies from הקדש. מליקה makes it able to become פסול. Squeezing out the blood brings פיגול, נותר and טמא. מעילה lasts until it goes out to בית הדשן.

steps.title: The stages of the burned bulls and goats
steps.stepSummary: The משנה gives the same stages for the פרים ושעירים הנשרפים. The difference is that their מעילה goes on even at בית הדשן, until the flesh is fully burned.
steps.simpleTranslation: Burned bulls and burned goats: מעילה applies from the time they are made holy. Once slaughtered, they can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight. Once their blood is sprinkled, one is liable for them because of פיגול, נותר and טמא. And מעילה applies to them even at the place of the ashes, until the flesh is burned up.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה goes on to a second kind of offering, the bulls and goats that are burned, and lists the same stages.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The pattern matches the bird עולה, with each act swapped for its match. שחיטה takes the place of מליקה, and sprinkling the blood takes the place of squeezing it out. The real difference is at the end: their מעילה does not stop at בית הדשן but lasts there until the flesh is burned up.

keyTerms.meaning: Bulls whose meat is burned outside the camp instead of being eaten or put on the מזבח
Goats that are burned in the same way
Their blood was sprinkled
Until it is burned up, scorched through

steps.whatToRemember: Both offerings follow the same pattern: הקדש, then the killing act, then the blood service, then the end of מעילה. But the burned bulls and goats keep מעילה even at בית הדשן, until the flesh is burned up.

phrases.english: Bulls that are burned and goats that are burned:
One is liable for misusing them from the moment they were consecrated.
Once they were slaughtered, they became able to be disqualified by one who immersed that day,
And by one who has not yet brought an atonement offering, and by being left overnight.
Once their blood was sprinkled,
One is liable for them due to piggul,
Notar, and ritual impurity,
And one is liable for misusing them in the place of the ashes
Until the flesh has been scorched.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the stage pattern of step 8 to the burned bulls and goats, with a different end point for מעילה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For the פרים ושעירים הנשרפים: מעילה applies from הקדש. שחיטה makes them able to become פסול. Sprinkling the blood brings פיגול, נותר and טמא. מעילה lasts even at בית הדשן until the flesh is burned up.

steps.title: The stages of an animal burnt offering
steps.stepSummary: An animal עולה has מעילה from הקדש. After שחיטה it can become פסול. After זריקה eating it brings liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא. Its hides have no מעילה, but its meat keeps מעילה until it goes out to בית הדשן.
steps.simpleTranslation: With a burnt offering, there is מעילה from the moment it is made holy. Once it is slaughtered, it can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight. Once its blood is thrown, a person who eats it is liable for פיגול, נותר and טמא. There is no מעילה on the hides, but there is מעילה on the meat until it goes out to the ash pile.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה now moves from bird offerings to an animal עולה. It runs the same stages for it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The first three stages match the pattern from the earlier steps. The new detail is at the end. Even after the blood is thrown, the meat of an עולה still has מעילה, because none of it ever becomes permitted to people. Only the hides are excluded.

keyTerms.meaning: A burnt offering, burned completely on the מזבח
One is liable for מעילה, the misuse of הקדש property
It became able to be disqualified
Hides (skins) of the animal
The ash pile where the remains are taken

phrases.english: The burnt offering: one is liable for misuse of it from when it was consecrated.
Once it was slaughtered, it became able to be disqualified
through a טבול יום, through a מחוסר כפורים, and through being left overnight.
Once its blood was thrown, one is liable for it
because of פיגול, נותר, and eating while impure.
And one is not liable for misuse of the hides,

phrases.aramaic: אֲבָל מוֹעֲלִין בַּבָּשָׂר עַד שֶׁתֵּצֵא לְבֵית הַדֶּשֶׁן.
phrases.english: but one is liable for misuse of the meat until it goes out to the place of the ashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the same four-stage pattern from the bird עולה and the פרים ושעירים הנשרפים to an animal עולה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An animal עולה has מעילה from הקדש. After זריקה there is no מעילה on the hides, but the meat keeps מעילה until it goes out to בית הדשן.

steps.title: The stages of sin, guilt and communal peace offerings
steps.stepSummary: A חטאת, an אשם and שלמי ציבור follow the same stages. After זריקה, however, the meat no longer has מעילה; only the אימורים keep מעילה until they go out to בית הדשן.
steps.simpleTranslation: With a sin offering, a guilt offering and communal peace offerings, there is מעילה from the moment they are made holy. Once they are slaughtered, they can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight. Once their blood is thrown, a person who eats them is liable for פיגול, נותר and טמא. There is no מעילה on the meat, but there is מעילה on their אימורים until they go out to the ash pile.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה runs the same stages for a חטאת, an אשם and שלמי ציבור. It points out how their last stage differs from the עולה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With these קרבנות, the meat is eaten by the כהנים. Once the blood is thrown and the meat becomes permitted to them, it no longer has מעילה. The אימורים still go to the מזבח, so they keep מעילה until they reach בית הדשן.

keyTerms.meaning: A sin offering
A guilt offering
Communal peace offerings, brought on behalf of the whole community
The fats and parts of the animal that are burned on the מזבח

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix this up with the עולה. With an עולה, the meat keeps מעילה after the blood is thrown. Here the meat loses מעילה, and only the אימורים keep it.

phrases.english: A sin offering, a guilt offering, and communal peace offerings:
one is liable for misuse of them from when they were consecrated.
Once they were slaughtered, they became able to be disqualified
through a טבול יום, through a מחוסר כפורים, and through being left overnight.
Once their blood was thrown, one is liable for them
because of פיגול, נותר, and eating while impure.
One is not liable for misuse of the meat,

phrases.aramaic: אֲבָל מוֹעֲלִין בְּאֵימוּרֵיהֶן עַד שֶׁיֵּצְאוּ לְבֵית הַדֶּשֶׁן.
phrases.english: but one is liable for misuse of their sacrificial portions until they go out to the place of the ashes.

steps.triggerLanguage: חַטָּאת, וְאָשָׁם, וְזִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי צִיבּוּר – מוֹעֲלִין בָּהֶן מִשֶּׁהוּקְדְּשׁוּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Same pattern as the עולה, but the last stage is different, because here the meat becomes permitted to the כהנים.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For a חטאת, an אשם and שלמי ציבור, after זריקה the meat has no מעילה, but the אימורים keep מעילה until בית הדשן.
steps.whyThisMatters: This shows the main idea behind the whole משנה: מעילה ends on whatever part has become permitted to people, and lasts on whatever part still belongs to the מזבח.

steps.title: The stages of the two loaves of שבועות
steps.stepSummary: The שתי הלחם have מעילה from הקדש. Once they form a crust in the oven, they can become פסול and the lambs can be slaughtered with them. Once the lambs' blood is thrown, the loaves bring liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא, and they have no מעילה at all.
steps.simpleTranslation: With the two loaves, there is מעילה from the moment they are made holy. Once they form a crust in the oven, they can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight, and the offering can be slaughtered with them. Once the blood of the lambs is thrown, a person who eats the loaves is liable for פיגול, נותר and טמא, and there is no more מעילה on them.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה moves from animals to a bread offering, the שתי הלחם of שבועות. It shows how the same stages work for it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For bread, forming a crust in the oven plays the role that שחיטה plays for an animal. The loaves depend on the two lambs, so the throwing of the lambs' blood is what permits them. At that point the loaves lose מעילה completely.

keyTerms.meaning: The two loaves brought on שבועות together with two lambs
They formed a crust (while baking)
Lambs, here the two lambs brought with the loaves
Misuse of הקדש property

phrases.english: The two loaves: one is liable for misuse of them from when they were consecrated.
Once they formed a crust in the oven, they became able to be disqualified
through a טבול יום, through a מחוסר כפורים, and through being left overnight,
and to have the offering slaughtered with them.
Once the blood of the lambs was thrown,

phrases.aramaic: חַיָּיבִין עֲלֵיהֶן מִשּׁוּם פִּיגּוּל, נוֹתָר, וְטָמֵא,
phrases.english: one is liable for them because of פיגול, נותר, and eating while impure,
and they have no misuse.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves the same pattern from animal offerings to a bread offering. The crust in the oven takes the place of שחיטה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The שתי הלחם can become פסול once they form a crust. Once the lambs' blood is thrown, they bring liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא and have no מעילה.

steps.title: The stages of the showbread
steps.stepSummary: The לחם הפנים has מעילה from הקדש. Once it forms a crust in the oven, it can become פסול through a טבול יום or a מחוסר כפורים, and it may be arranged on the שולחן.
steps.simpleTranslation: With the showbread, there is מעילה from the moment it is made holy. Once it forms a crust in the oven, it can become פסול through a טבול יום or a מחוסר כפורים, and it is ready to be arranged on the Table.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה begins the same series of stages for the לחם הפנים, the bread placed on the שולחן in the היכל.
steps.deeperAnalysis: As with the שתי הלחם, forming a crust is the point where the bread can become פסול. Here that same moment also makes it ready to be set out on the שולחן. Notice that being left overnight is not listed here.

keyTerms.meaning: The showbread, set out on the שולחן in the היכל
To be arranged (set out in rows)
The golden Table in the היכל

phrases.english: The showbread: one is liable for misuse of it from when it was consecrated.
Once it formed a crust in the oven, it became able to be disqualified
through a טבול יום and through a מחוסר כפורים,
and to be arranged on the Table.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the bread offerings, moving from the שתי הלחם to the לחם הפנים.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The לחם הפנים has מעילה from הקדש. Once it forms a crust, it can become פסול through a טבול יום or a מחוסר כפורים, and it may be arranged on the שולחן.

steps.title: After the frankincense bowls are offered, the showbread loses מעילה
steps.stepSummary: Once the בזיכין are offered, eating the לחם הפנים brings liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא, and the bread no longer has מעילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Once the bowls of frankincense have been offered, a person is liable for the bread because of פיגול, נותר and טמא, and it has no מעילה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה finishes the stages of the לחם הפנים from Step 13. The final stage comes when the frankincense bowls are offered.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For the לחם הפנים, offering the בזיכין works like זריקה does for an animal: it is the act that makes the rest permitted. From then on the כהנים may eat the bread, so the prohibitions of פיגול, נותר and טמא apply to it. Since the bread now belongs to the כהנים to eat, it is no longer treated as ה׳'s property, and מעילה ends.

keyTerms.meaning: The two bowls of frankincense placed beside the לחם הפנים and burned when the bread is removed
An offering made invalid by a wrong intention about when it would be eaten or burned
Sacrificial meat or bread left over past its time limit
The prohibition against using or benefiting from הקדש

phrases.english: Once the bowls of frankincense were offered,

phrases.aramaic: חַיָּיבִין עָלָיו מִשּׁוּם פִּיגּוּל, נוֹתָר, וְטָמֵא,
phrases.english: one is liable for it because of פיגול, נותר and טמא,
and it has no מעילה.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the stages of the לחם הפנים begun in Step 13.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Offering the בזיכין permits the לחם הפנים: liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא begins, and מעילה ends.

steps.title: מנחות: מעילה from הקדש, and they can become פסול once placed in a vessel
steps.stepSummary: מנחות have מעילה from הקדש. Once they are made holy in a כלי שרת, they can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight.
steps.simpleTranslation: Meal offerings have מעילה from the time they are made הקדש. Once they become holy in a vessel, they can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה now applies the same stages to ordinary flour offerings. Here we have the first two stages: when מעילה starts, and when the offering can become פסול.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Verbal הקדש alone is enough to create מעילה. A higher holiness comes when the flour is put into a כלי שרת. Only from that point can the מנחה become פסול by contact with a טבול יום or a מחוסר כפורים, or by being left overnight.

keyTerms.meaning: Flour offerings brought to the בית המקדש
Made holy by being placed in a כלי שרת, a vessel used for the Temple service
A person who immersed today but must wait until nightfall to be fully טהור
A person who still has to bring an atonement offering to finish becoming טהור
Being left overnight, which makes certain holy items פסול

phrases.english: Meal offerings: one is liable for מעילה with them from when they were consecrated.
Once they were made holy in a vessel,
they became able to be disqualified by a טבול יום,
by a מחוסר כפורים, and by being left overnight.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves from the לחם הפנים to ordinary מנחות, using the same stage pattern.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: מנחות have מעילה from הקדש and can become פסול once made holy in a כלי שרת.

steps.title: Once the קומץ is offered: the שירים lose מעילה, but the קומץ keeps it
steps.stepSummary: After the קומץ is offered, the מנחה brings liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא. The שירים no longer have מעילה, but the קומץ keeps מעילה until it goes out to בית הדשן.
steps.simpleTranslation: Once the handful has been offered, one is liable for the מנחה because of פיגול, נותר and טמא. There is no מעילה with the leftovers, but there is מעילה with the handful until it goes out to the place of the ashes.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the final stage for מנחות. Offering the קומץ splits the מנחה into two parts with different rules.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The קומץ does for a מנחה what זריקה does for an animal: it permits the שירים to the כהנים, so they lose מעילה. The קומץ itself belongs entirely to the מזבח, so like the אימורים in Step 11 it keeps מעילה even after it is burned, until it is taken out to בית הדשן.

keyTerms.meaning: The handful of flour taken from a מנחה and burned on the מזבח
The rest of the מנחה after the קומץ is taken, eaten by the כהנים
The place outside where the ashes from the מזבח are brought

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה's pattern: מעילה starts with הקדש. The item can become פסול once it reaches its next level of holiness. Once the permitting act happens (זריקה, the בזיכין, or the קומץ), the parts that are eaten lose מעילה, while the parts that belong to the מזבח keep it until they reach בית הדשן.

phrases.english: Once the handful was offered,

phrases.aramaic: חַיָּיבִין עָלָיו מִשּׁוּם פִּיגּוּל, נוֹתָר, וְטָמֵא.
phrases.english: one is liable for it because of פיגול, נותר and טמא.
And there is no מעילה with the remainder,
but there is מעילה with the handful
until it goes out to the place of the ashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the stages of מנחות begun in Step 15.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: After the קומץ is offered, the שירים lose מעילה, while the קומץ keeps מעילה until it reaches בית הדשן.

steps.title: רב and רבי יוחנן argue about benefiting from the ash heap on the altar
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא opens with an אמוראים dispute. Is someone who benefits from the תפוח, the round heap of ash on top of the מזבח, liable for מעילה? רב says no; רבי יוחנן says yes.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was stated: if someone benefits from the round ash heap on top of the altar, רב says there is no מעילה with it, and רבי יוחנן says there is מעילה with it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins by presenting a dispute between רב and רבי יוחנן. It is setting up the discussion that will follow.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה said holy items keep מעילה until they go out to בית הדשן. The ash piled in the middle of the מזבח has already finished being burned but has not yet been taken out. רב says benefiting from it brings no מעילה, and רבי יוחנן says it does. The next steps narrow down when they argue and give each side's reason.

keyTerms.meaning: The discussion of the אמוראים on the משנה
The round heap of ash collected in the middle of the מזבח
One who benefits from something

steps.confusionAlert: This is not about the ash that was already taken out to בית הדשן. It is about ash that is still piled on top of the מזבח.

phrases.english: GEMARA: It was stated:
one who benefits from the ash of the round heap
phrases.notes: תפוח literally means apple. It is the name for the round pile of ash in the middle of the מזבח.

phrases.english: that is on top of the altar,
רב says: there is no מעילה with it,
and רבי יוחנן says: there is מעילה with it.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִיתְּמַר, הַנֶּהֱנֶה מֵאֵפֶר תַּפּוּחַ שֶׁעַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins the גמרא, raising a case connected to the משנה's rule of מעילה lasting until בית הדשן.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רב: no מעילה for benefiting from the תפוח on the מזבח. רבי יוחנן: there is מעילה.

steps.title: Pinpointing when רב and רבי יוחנן argue
steps.stepSummary: Before תרומת הדשן, everyone agrees there is מעילה in the ashes. The argument is only about the time after תרומת הדשן.
steps.simpleTranslation: Before the removal of the ashes, everyone agrees that one who benefits from it is liable for מעילה. They only argue about after the removal of the ashes.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא narrows down the argument from Step 17 so we know exactly which moment it is about. This sets up the reasons each side will give next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: תרומת הדשן is the daily מצוה of taking a shovelful of ashes off the מזבח. Before that מצוה is done, the ashes clearly still have a job to do, so everyone agrees they are holy. The real question is what happens once that מצוה is finished.

keyTerms.meaning: The daily removal of a shovelful of ashes from the מזבח
Everyone agrees
They disagree

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think רב says there is never מעילה in the תפוח. He agrees there is מעילה before תרומת הדשן, and he only disagrees about afterward.

phrases.english: Before the removal of the ashes
everyone agrees
that one is liable for misuse with it.
phrases.notes: "It" is the תפוח, the ash heap on the מזבח from Step 17.

phrases.english: When they disagree,
it is after the removal of the ashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Narrows the dispute stated in Step 17 to the time after תרומת הדשן.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Before תרומת הדשן there is מעילה according to everyone. The dispute is only about after it.

steps.title: רב's reason: the מצוה is already done
steps.stepSummary: רב says there is no מעילה after תרומת הדשן because the ash's מצוה has been completed.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב says: there is no מעילה with it, because its מצוה has already been done.
steps.whatsHappening: רב explains why he holds there is no מעילה after תרומת הדשן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The rule behind רב's view is that once a holy item's מצוה is finished, it loses its מעילה. After תרומת הדשן, the ash has nothing left to do, so it is no longer holy enough for מעילה.

keyTerms.meaning: There is no liability for מעילה
Its מצוה has been done (completed)

phrases.english: Rav says: one is not liable for misuse with it,
since its מצוה has been done.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives רב's reasoning for the time after תרומת הדשן.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: After תרומת הדשן there is no מעילה, because the ash's מצוה is finished.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן's reason from the פסוק about priestly clothing
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן brings the פסוק about the כהן's garments. Since taking the ashes out still requires בגדי כהונה, the ash is still holy.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן says: since it is written, 'And the כהן shall put on his linen garment, etc.,' and taking out the ashes still requires priestly clothing, the ash remains in its holiness.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן proves from a פסוק that the ashes are still holy even after תרומת הדשן, so there is still מעילה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says the כהן changes into 'other garments' to carry the ashes outside, and those are still בגדי כהונה. If the תורה demands priestly clothing for that job, the ash must still be holy. So according to רבי יוחנן, the ash's job is not fully over.

keyTerms.meaning: His linen garment (the כהן's tunic)
Priestly garments
It stays in its holiness

steps.whyThisMatters: This shows the core of the argument: רב says the מצוה ended at תרומת הדשן, while רבי יוחנן says carrying out the ashes is still part of the holy process.

phrases.english: And Rabbi Yoḥanan says:
Since it is written:
"And the priest shall put on his linen garment, etc."
since it requires priestly garments,
it remains in its holiness.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposing reasoning to רב in Step 19.
steps.raayaObject: That the ash is still holy after תרומת הדשן, so there is מעילה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: ויקרא 6:3–4: carrying out the ashes requires (other) priestly garments.

steps.title: A משנה seems to go against רב
steps.stepSummary: A משנה says there is מעילה 'until it goes out to the בית הדשן.' That means מעילה lasts beyond תרומת הדשן, which is hard for רב.
steps.simpleTranslation: We learned in a משנה: there is מעילה with them until it goes out to the place of ashes. This is a difficulty for רב!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רב from a משנה about offerings that are burned on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה makes מעילה last until the ash actually leaves for the בית הדשן, the place outside where the ashes are dumped. That suggests the ash is still holy while it sits on the מזבח, even after תרומת הדשן. This matches רבי יוחנן and goes against רב.

keyTerms.meaning: The place of ashes, where ashes are taken out to
Until it goes out
A difficulty (challenge)

phrases.english: We learned: one is liable for misuse with them
until it goes out to the place of ashes,
this is difficult for Rav!

steps.triggerLanguage: תְּנַן מוֹעֲלִין בָּהֶן עַד שֶׁתֵּצֵא לְבֵית הַדֶּשֶׁן קַשְׁיָא לְרַב
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks רב's position from Step 19 using a משנה.
steps.kashyaTarget: רב's view that there is no מעילה after תרומת הדשן.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה says מעילה lasts until the ash actually goes out to the בית הדשן, which is later than תרומת הדשן.

steps.title: רב reads the משנה as 'until it is ready to go out'
steps.stepSummary: רב answers that the משנה means until the ash is fit to go out to the בית הדשן, not until it actually leaves.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב can say to you: the משנה means until it is fit to go out to the place of ashes.
steps.whatsHappening: רב defends himself by reading the משנה's words differently.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Instead of 'until it goes out,' רב reads 'until it is seen as ready to go out.' Once the ash is burned and תרומת הדשן has been done, it is ready to be taken out, and that is exactly when רב says מעילה ends. So the משנה fits רב after all.

keyTerms.meaning: Until it is seen as fit (ready)

steps.whatToRemember: רב: מעילה ends after תרומת הדשן because the מצוה is done. רבי יוחנן: מעילה continues because taking out the ashes still needs בגדי כהונה. רב reads the משנה as 'until it is fit to go out.'

phrases.english: Rav could say to you:
until it is fit for the place of ashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא of Step 21 on behalf of רב.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Re-reading the wording of the משנה
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה means until the ash physically goes out to the בית הדשן.
steps.terutzMaskana: The משנה means until the ash is ready to go out, which happens at תרומת הדשן, so it fits רב.
